author: Russell Brand
description:
Russell Brand sits down with Alex Jones to map out what genuine survival looks like for America as centralized power continues to tighten its grip on every aspect of ordinary life. Russell puts forward the idea of fully decentralized energy independent food independent communities run democratically by the people who live in them. Alex Jones points to the Amish as living proof that this blueprint already works, a community living on average eight years longer than everyone else with no autism and none of the chronic illness plaguing modern society simply by following the principles of Leviticus. Russell and Alex coin the term blockchain Amish as the model for the future and they both agree the FBI and CIA would not be pleased to see it happen.
